purpose: Measure headroom for selective looking WITHOUT any learned gaze policy, with heuristic-gaze viability test.

arms.name: uniform_downsample
arms.description: Uniform downsample to matched pixel budget

arms.name: random_glimpses
arms.description: Random glimpses at matched pixel budget

arms.name: oracle_glimpses
arms.description: Oracle glimpses using ground-truth target location at matched pixel budget

arms.name: heuristic_gaze_zero_training
arms.description: Zero-training heuristic-gaze arm: glimpses chosen by the trunk's own gist-level uncertainty or attention (no learned parameters)

arms.name: k_glimpses_plus_gist
arms.description: K glimpses of 112 px plus a low-res gist

seeds_definition.note: Seeds do not vary trunk weights; they vary data sampling and stochastic glimpse/heuristic choices as applicable

thresholds_chosen.name: heuristic_recovers_fraction_of_oracle_random_gap
thresholds_chosen.rationale: VIABILITY threshold - heuristic must recover >=30% of oracle-random gap

thresholds_chosen.name: heuristic_min_seeds
thresholds_chosen.rationale: Heuristic must meet viability on >= 2 of 3 seeds

HEADROOM.rule: oracle - max(random, uniform) >= 10 pp at some budget, on all 3 seeds

VIABILITY.rule: heuristic recovers >= 30% of the oracle-random gap at the same budget on >= 2 of 3 seeds

pass_rule.note: A headroom pass alone does NOT authorize learned-gaze work. Both HEADROOM and VIABILITY must be satisfied as specified.

fail_predeclaration.meaning: If gate0 fails, no learned-gaze work is permitted until a new preregistration is written and approved.
